item.description:

item.title: Show HN: I created a cross-platform GUI for the JJ VCS (Git compatible)
item.description:
📝 macOS Download for macOS Windows Download for Windows Linux (Ubuntu/Debian) Download for Linux Restore your repo to any point in time with the Operation Log. View combined diffs of multiple commits, or the diff between commits Apply or revert hunks of any diff, files, commits, or even multiple commits at once Use custom revsets to select which commits are shown. Drag and drop rebase Duplicate, split, abandon, revert, absorb, squash, and more Keep your bookmarks managed.
🔗 Read more: https://judojj.com

item.title: J.P. Morgan's OpenAI loan is strange
item.description:
📝 Putting our investor hat on, the possible returns for investing $1,000 into OpenAI look like this:Cost: $1,000Case 1 (90%): OpenAI goes bankrupt. Return: $0Case 2 (9%): OpenAI becomes a big successful company and goes 10x. Return: $10,000Case 3 (1%): OpenAI becomes the big new thing and goes 100x.
🔗 Read more: https://marketunpack.com/j-p-morgans-openai-loan-is-strange/

item.title: When a stadium adds AI to everything, it's worse experience for everyone
item.description:
📝 Case in point: Let's talk about my favorite concession stand at BMO last year, a place that served rotisserie chicken with waffle fries and chicken sandwiches. I returned to the same concession stand yesterday and here's their new menu:When your checkout stand relies on computer vision, it's probably confusing to have half a dozen different menu items that fans can enjoy. This was a quick service "market" style place and last year, you'd just grab stuff off a shelf, and checkout quickly from staff at multiple registers.
🔗 Read more: https://a.wholelottanothing.org/bmo-stadium-in-la-added-ai-to-everything-and-what-they-got-was-a-worse-experience-for-everyone/

item.title: iOS 26.1 lets users control Liquid Glass transparency
item.description:
📝 1, Apple has introduced a new setting that's designed to allow users to customize the look of Liquid Glass. The toggle lets users select from a clear look for Liquid Glass, or a tinted look. Clear is the current Liquid Glass design, which is more transparent and shows the background underneath buttons, bars, and menus, while tinted increases the opacity of Liquid Glass and adds more contrast.
🔗 Read more: https://www.macrumors.com/2025/10/20/ios-26-1-liquid-glass-toggle/
